components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Gold-filled action button for the single committing action on a view (Book, Confirm).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: var(--font-body, 'Inter', sans-serif); background: var(--color-sun, #E8B84B); color: var(--color-dark-oak, #2C1810); font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; padding: 1rem 3rem; border: none; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 4px); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-sun-dark, #D4A030); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-sun, #E8B84B); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Terracotta-outlined secondary action; fills on hover. Used for the room-card 'Book' link.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-block; font-family: var(--font-body, 'Inter', sans-serif); background: transparent; color: var(--color-terracotta-dark, #A67B52); font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-terracotta, #C4956A); border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 4px); text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--color-terracotta, #C4956A); color: var(--color-white, #FFFFFF); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-sun, #E8B84B); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form text field with a gold focus border and glow; white fill on the warm canvas.

components.name: Amenity Chip
components.description: Small olive pill marking a room feature; non-interactive label.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; font-family: var(--font-body, 'Inter', sans-serif); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-olive, #7A8B5B); background: rgba(122, 139, 91, 0.1); padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 100px; }

narrative.overview:
An Andalusian house keeps a shaded patio at its heart: whitewashed walls that hold the midday heat at bay, cool stone underfoot, olive and clay just beyond the arcade, and a single shaft of light crossing the tiles as the day turns. Finca La Carla's visual system is that patio — a warm neutral field, a small earth-and-sea palette, and one bright shaft of sunlight saved for the moment a guest commits.

The mood is warm, calm, and understated. This is a small rural hotel, not a transaction engine, so the interface stays quiet: generous whitespace, gentle depth, no spectacle. Color, shadow, and motion are restrained; the craft shows in proportion and detail rather than loudness. Type does the emotional work — a high-contrast serif for display against a clean grotesque for reading.

Depth stays soft, like shade rather than structure: surfaces sit near-flat at rest and lift only slightly on hover, and every shadow is tinted with the dark oak brown instead of neutral black, so nothing ever reads as cold glass.
keyCharacteristics: Warm off-white canvas (Warm Whitewash) with cream-plaster bands for rhythm, never grey.
Earth-and-sea palette — Clay Terracotta, Olive Grove, Deep Mediterranean — with Sunlit Gold as the single bright action voice.
Serif display (Playfair Display) over grotesque body (Inter); uppercase tracked labels and bilingual eyebrows.
Restrained geometry: 4px on small controls, 8px on panels, 16px on cards, pill chips.
Gentle, warm-tinted shadows; flat at rest, a small lift on hover.
A recurring rotated diamond motif (the "andalusian divider") as the one ornament.

rules.name: The One Bright Voice Rule
rules.body: Sunlit Gold is the only saturated color and covers no more than ~10% of any screen. Its scarcity is what makes the booking action read instantly.

rules.name: The Warm-Neutral Rule
rules.body: There is no neutral grey in the palette. Whites lean warm (whitewash, cream plaster), darks lean oak brown, and even inactive borders use warm stone. A cold #888 is always the wrong answer.

rules.name: The Bilingual Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Section eyebrows are uppercase, tracked, and Spanish against English body copy — a small, consistent signature of place. Keep them warm taupe, never gold.

rules.name: The Serif-Voice Rule
rules.body: Playfair is reserved for titles, brand wordmarks, and monetary amounts. Never set body copy, labels, or form text in the display serif.

rules.name: The Warm Shadow Rule
rules.body: All shadows are tinted with Dark Oak; a neutral-black shadow is never used.

rules.name: The Small-Lift Rule
rules.body: Hover elevation is capped at a 4px translate (2px on buttons). Big jumps and dramatic rises break the calm.

dos: Do keep the canvas warm (Warm Whitewash / Cream Plaster) and darks oak-tinted; every neutral should carry a little heat.
Do reserve Sunlit Gold for actions and focus — one bright voice per view (The One Bright Voice Rule).
Do tint all shadows with rgba(44, 24, 16, …) and keep hover lifts to ≤4px.
Do pair a Spanish uppercase eyebrow with English body copy on every section (The Bilingual Eyebrow Rule).
Do set titles, wordmarks, and monetary amounts in Playfair Display, and everything else in Inter.
Do keep small controls at 4px, panels at 8px, cards at 16px, and chips as full pills.
donts: Don't introduce cold greys, pure #000/#888, or neutral-black shadows.
Don't flood a screen with terracotta, olive, or gold; they are accents over a neutral base.
Don't set body copy, labels, or form fields in the display serif.
Don't add decorative geometry beyond the diamond divider motif.
Don't chase a generic OTA/booking-widget or stock-Bootstrap look; craft stays boutique and calm.
